Initial release of sum_and_translate_install_check.

- Checks if the Python environment is ready for PDF summarization and translation (langchain + paddleocr/PPStructureV3 + HTML–PDF rendering).
- Offers both dependency check and on-demand installation of required libraries.
- Usage instructions provided for verification and auto-installation modes.
- Details given for system requirements and project module handling.
- Intended to be called before running PDF summary/translation pipelines or upon user request.
